title: Concurrent lane fast checks share the machine instead of each saturating it
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 S1 retro: npm run fast took 2260s (test 1101s) with 4 lanes each running fast at --test-concurrency=0; load avg 70-95.
Outcome: fast-check caps test concurrency by host load or a shared slot lock under .krn/tmp so N parallel fasts finish no slower than serial.
Proof: a test runs two fast-check test phases against one slot lock and observes them serialized.
